champion.tips: CASSIOPEIA TIPS AND TRICKS In the early game, always keep an eye on your mana pool when trading as it goes quicker than you expect when trading with the enemy. Only commit to a trade with the enemy when you’ve successfully landed a Q . You can follow the initial Q with multiple E ’s afterwards for a favourable trade. Avoid going for auto-attack trades with the enemy ADC as they’ll always win them as you’re an AP champion and they’re AD. Try to commit to trades when you have lots of mana available.
champion.builds: THE BEST CASSIOPEIA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Cassiopeia Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Manaflow Band and Transcendence in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Rod of Ages as your first item, followed by Archangel's Staff and . For your last 3 items, you should build Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Liandry's Torment and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 52.9% winrate over 819 matches played. Optional Your second option for Cassiopeia Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Archangel's Staff, which you should build first, followed by Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your second item and as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Liandry's Torment, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is E - Q - W. In the current patch, this build has a 52.6% win rate over 285 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blackfire Torch as your first item, then Rod of Ages as a second item and as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Liandry's Torment and Zhonya's Hourglass. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 54.4% win rate across 180 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Cassiopeia Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Presence of Mind, Legend: Haste and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Rylai's Crystal Scepter as your first item, then finish Archangel's Staff as your second item, and as third item. The last 3 options are Liandry's Torment, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. The ability order for this build is E - Q - W.
